slots.name: German yield change
slots.sentence: The German 10-year yield , the euro zone benchmark, was down 6.5 basis points on Friday, as investors preferred the relative safety of German bonds compared to their euro zone counterparts.

slots.name: French yield
slots.sentence: In France, the 10-year yield was down 4 bp at 4.892%, pushing the gap between the German and French 10-year yields as wide as 149 bps, the widest level since the euro zone debt crisis in 2012.

slots.name: European bond yields status
slots.sentence: In Europe, longer-dated sovereign bond prices rose on the day, although those in more indebted countries, like France and Italy, lagged the gains in Germany, reflecting growing investor demand for protection against rising fiscal risks.
